primary_source.author: Lars Hörmander
primary_source.title: The Analysis of Linear Partial Differential Operators III

source_correspondence: S3–S6: the flat majorant and characteristic quadratic completion behind Hörmander III Lemmas 24.4.3–24.4.5; no operator estimate from Lemma 24.4.5 is claimed.
S1–S2 and S7: smooth power and divided-difference square arguments corresponding to Lemmas 24.4.8–24.4.9, using the programme’s complete even/odd extension.
S8: the principal-symbol commutant construction concluding Theorem 24.4.1, including an explicit two-width independence calculation.
Theorem 24.4.1 and the analytic estimates in Lemmas 24.4.6–24.4.7 are not proved by this symbol supplement.
